title: Add high-speed data
body: Only needed after {fup} GB, once your speed drops. Plenty left for now.

title: Add more days
body: A second pack stacks on top, so you keep the days you already have.

title: Add another pack if this one runs out
body: If your {validity} days end while you are still away, we add another {price} pack to your bill instead of slowing you down.

title: Turn voicemail off
body: Unanswered calls divert to voicemail and still use your minutes. We'll show the cost here as soon as there is one.

title: Turn off roaming
body: Stops calls, texts and data outside India straight away. Turn it back on whenever you like.
